title: Iron ore tube vein in a boat pit

tellings.quote: So here I'm down inside of one of these {quote} {unquote} boat pits. Mhm. And this is an image This is a tube.

plain: A guest named Jeffrey says he climbed down into one of the so-called boat pits, large pits cut into the rock on the Giza Plateau near Egypt's pyramids. He shows a picture of what he calls a tube, which the story describes as a tube-shaped vein of iron ore. He tells it as part of a claim that a hidden energy system lies beneath the pyramids.
